//_broken_headers: These are all structurally wrappable, but their declaring header (or one it drags in, e.g. generic/allocators/dynamic_aligned_allocator.h) fails to compile under GCC's -Wtemplate-body (missing #include <vector>/<cassert>, undeclared aligned_free/S_ERROR in template bodies) -- a pre-existing bug in Simulant itself, unrelated to the generated bindings. Remove these once that's fixed upstream.
//_unimplemented: Declared in a header but with no matching definition anywhere in Simulant -- either never implemented at all, or (circle/circle_outline) the .cpp defines a different, undeclared overload instead (an apparent stale header left over from a signature change). Either way a pre-existing engine bug, not a generator issue -- wrapping the declared signature mechanically produces a linker error the moment anything else in the same source file (e.g. Texture::width(), or any other function in functions.cpp) is used, since static libraries link at object-file granularity. Remove once fixed upstream.
